Capital.title: A simulated quantitative fund
Capital.description: FGV Quant Capital is the league's simulated fund. It combines two systematic strategies in Brazilian equities, Pairs Trading and Momentum, run with explicit rules, transaction costs and a monthly management report against the CDI.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.simulated: Simulated fund, for educational purposes only. It is not a real investment fund.
disclaimer.noMoney: No real money is involved: nothing here raises, manages or receives third-party funds.
disclaimer.past: Past (simulated) performance is not an indication of future results.
disclaimer.advice: Nothing on this site is investment advice.

notes.source: Prices from Yahoo Finance and CDI from the Central Bank of Brazil (SGS 12), run through the same code as the monthly report. Official figures come out in the monthly report, with Economatica data, and may differ from this preview.

chart.title: Life of a trade
chart.aria: Illustrative chart of a pair's z-score over time, with entry bands at plus and minus 2 standard deviations and exit bands at plus and minus 0.5. The position opens when the z-score crosses the entry band and closes when it returns to the exit band.
chart.note: Illustrative series, generated only to show the rule. It is not a real trade from the fund.

converged.title: Convergence
converged.body: The spread comes back to the exit band and the position is closed.

diverged.title: Divergence
diverged.body: The spread widens instead of converging and the position is closed.

carry.title: Carry-over
carry.body: The position stays open into the next month, within the trading-day limit.

exposure.title: Portfolio exposure
exposure.note: Percent of equity, in the strategy's current configuration.

risk.title: Why combine the two
risk.p1: The two strategies make money for different reasons: Pairs Trading relies on spreads converging, Momentum on trends persisting. As a result, their returns barely move together: the correlation between them is {correlation} since inception.
risk.p2: The effect shows up in volatility. Together, they form a fund that swings less than either strategy on its own.

volatility.body: Standard deviation of returns, on an annual basis. It measures how much results swing.

sharpe.body: Return above the CDI divided by volatility: how much the fund delivers per unit of risk.

drawdown.body: The largest cumulative fall from a peak to the following trough.

correlation.body: Ranges from −1 to 1. Near zero, it means the strategies move independently.

process.title: A monthly management cycle
process.description: The fund reproduces the routine of a quantitative asset manager, from research to reporting.

research.title: Research and selection
research.body: Update the asset universe, test the statistical quality of the pairs and recompute the momentum scores.

execution.title: Simulated execution
execution.body: Open and close positions following each strategy's rules, net of transaction costs.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.body: Track z-scores, volatility, drawdown and correlation, and consider incremental parameter adjustments.

report.title: Management report
report.body: Publish the month's performance against the CDI, the breakdown by strategy and the attribution by asset.

reports.title: Management reports on LinkedIn
reports.legal: FGV Quant Capital is a fictional educational project that aims to rigorously simulate the operations and routines of a quantitative asset manager. Data, assumptions and results are simulated, may differ materially from actual market conditions and are not a promise of returns, an investment offer or a recommendation to buy or sell securities.
